synthesizedFacts.fact: Wrinkle fillers provide a temporary reduction in the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles by using ingredients like silicones and humectants.
The effects of instant wrinkle fillers are not permanent and typically last for several hours.
Wrinkle fillers often contain ingredients like cyclopentasiloxane and dimethicone, which create a smooth, velvety texture on the skin.
